title: sajaaiye mehfile masarrat
body:
sajaaiye mehfile masarrat wo aa rahe hai wo aa rahe hai
jahan pe jinki hai hukoomat, wo aa rahe hai wo aa rahe hai
<<DIVIDER>>
wo jinka farmaan hai mashiyat, wo aa rahe hai wo aa rahe hai
hai jinke qabze me saari qudrat, wo aa rahe hai wo aa rahe hai
<<DIVIDER>>
yazeed se inteqaam hoga, layeeno ka qatle aam hoga
hai qatm zulmo sitam ki mohlat, wo aa rahe hai wo aa rahe hai
<<DIVIDER>>
payaame haq ko dabaane waale, ye jhoote sikke chalaane waale
dilo pe taari hai jinki dehshat, wo aa rahe hai wo aa rahe hai
<<DIVIDER>>
hai koun kaazib hai koun aalim, hai koun mazloom koun zaalim
hai jinko maloom sab haqeeqat, wo aa rahe hai wo aa rahe hai
<<DIVIDER>>
bade the daawe bahadduri ke, lie hue phir rahe the durre
ab aaye aage ho jis me himmat, wo aa rahe hai wo aa rahe hai
<<DIVIDER>>
dilo ko apne zara tatolo, na haq kisi na daba ke rakkho
hai jiski sabse badi adaalat, wo aa rahe hai wo aa rahe hai
<<DIVIDER>>
andhera har dil se door hoga, tamaam aalam pe noor hoga
mitegi dono jaha'n se zulmat, wo aa rahe hai wo aa rahe hai
<<DIVIDER>>
khuli dilo ki kitaab rakkho, nazar me jalwo ki taab rakkho
hai inke paikar me noore wehdat, wo aa rahe hai wo aa rahe hai
<<DIVIDER>>
mohabbate murtaza bachaao, dilo ko karbobala banaao
wo lenge tumse hisaabe ulfat, wo aa rahe hai wo aa rahe hai
